text:
Devon: Quick deploy heads-up — planning to roll canary for v2-inference-routing at 21:30 UTC (today). 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30m/30m/30m. Cohorts: EU-small, NA-beta; Intl held for later. I'll kick off deploy at :30. Please confirm smoke person + rollback readiness. Rollout config:
```
canary_percentages: [5,25,100]
stage_durations_min: [30,30,30]
cohorts: ["EU-small","NA-beta"]
rollback_on_error: true
max_error_rate: 0.05
```
If no objections I'll freeze promos and feature flags for 2h.

Sam: Oncall + available. I'll run smoke tasks and check latency p50/p99 and error-rate dashboards. ETA 21:25 to be ready. If anything >0.02 error or p99 jumps +200ms -> call rollback. I'll post smoke script output.

Liang: One ask: can we set min_replicas=2 for the eu-small pool during the ramp? Last time cold-starts skewed p99. If ops approves I can patch load balancer weights too.

Maya: I'll disable the marketing promo at 21:15 (prod flag: marketing_banner). Also removing canary users from the experiment pool now. :thumbsup:

Anna (product): Confirmed hold on promos and experiment. Cohort selection OK from product side — EU-small includes traffic only from customers with "tier:standard". Revert plan approved.

ops-bot: Deploy job scheduled by Devon for 2025-11-02T21:30:00Z — job id: deploy-8791. Watch channel: #deploy-8791. (automated)

Sam: smoke script (local):
```
./tools/smoke.sh --target v2-inference-routing --checks latency,error-rate,redis
```
I'll paste results when done.

Liang: ops ok to bump min_replicas. Patching now. Will monitor queue lengths.

Maya: Promo flag disabled. Verified: marketing_banner=false in prod.

Devon: Thanks — I'll start the canary at 21:30. I'll ping here at each roll step. Backout plan: revert routing config to v1 and scale down v2 pool; target rollback time <5 min once triggered.

Sam: acknowledged. I'll be watching dashboards (+101 pager oncall).
